description: This file contains the implementation of the Memory Protection Unit (MPU) driver for NXP SOCs within the Zephyr RTOS, including functions for configuring static and dynamic MPU regions, initialization, and permission management.

methods.name: mpu_partition_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if an MPU region partition's start address and size are valid and properly aligned.

methods.name: region_init
methods.description: Initializes an MPU region with base, end, and attribute configuration.

methods.name: region_allocate_and_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes an MPU region at a specified index.

methods.name: mpu_configure_regions_from_dt
methods.description: Configures MPU regions based on device tree memory attributes.

methods.name: get_region_attr_from_mpu_partition_info
methods.description: Sets MPU region attributes based on partition info, ignoring base and size for NXP MPU.

methods.name: mpu_configure_region
methods.description: Programs a specific MPU region with a given partition configuration.

methods.name: mpu_sram_partitioning
methods.description: Partitions SRAM for stack guard regions by splitting existing regions.

methods.name: mpu_configure_regions
methods.description: Programs multiple MPU regions over a background area, with optional sanity checks.

methods.name: mpu_configure_static_mpu_regions
methods.description: Programs static MPU regions based on configuration.

methods.name: mpu_configure_dynamic_mpu_regions
methods.description: Programs dynamic MPU regions based on configuration.

methods.name: z_arm_mpu_init
methods.description: Initializes the MPU with fixed and device tree regions, setting up static and dynamic regions.
